scope: Saved public encoder static-preparation terminal receipt validated offline against current committed and locally built production registry and fixed profile; no asset bodies, browser, network or model run

byteSemantics.verifiedBytes: Completed decoded asset body bytes after size, SHA-256 and cache-write obligations.
byteSemantics.networkBytes: Verified decoded body bytes sourced from fetch rather than CacheStorage; not HTTP wire bytes or necessarily a cold HTTP-cache transfer.
byteSemantics.cacheBytes: Verified decoded body bytes sourced from CacheStorage.

limits: Offline replay validates the supplied terminal receipt and exact metadata; it does not independently reread browser cached bodies.
This terminal archive has no worker identity or complete progress stream, so channel sequencing, readiness duration and lifecycle ownership are not replayed here.
Static preparation is separate from embedding/query/generation and their unchanged inference deadlines.
No external Hugging Face preparation feature was implemented or needed for this recorded same-origin completion.
